title: Button Stuck in Hover Style After Being Covered by a Newly-Visible Control
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.7.2-stable, 4.6.3-stable, 4.5.2-stable

### System information

Godot v4.7.2.stable - Ubuntu 26.04 LTS 26.04 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (ADL GT2) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-1240P (16 threads) - 15.32 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When a button is clicked to `show()` another control which would hide said button (i.e. a "full rect" anchored control with `MOUSE_FILTER_STOP`), the button remains stuck in hover style until either:

1. The mouse is moved by the user,
2. The `mouse_filter` on the button is set to `MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE`, or my personal favorite,
3. The mouse is warped anywhere, even to its current position

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e0955659-efa8-4c22-8723-e5c7428bddec

This bug happens in all window modes, embedded or not.

The hover style getting stuck on also happens if the button was pressed via the enter key (i.e. after tabbing it into focus), though in this case the mouse must still be hovering the button when the enter key is pressed for it to get stuck on.

As well, it doesn't need to be the same button that was pressed for this bug to occur. If Button A causes the fullscreen covering control to become visible and is currently focused, and Button B is being hovered by the mouse, pressing enter (which "presses" Button A) will cause Button B to have stuck hover styling until the same conditions above are fulfilled.

### Steps to reproduce

Main:
1. Open MRP
2. Click top button
3. Hover style on top button is stuck until above conditions are met, even if you `grab_focus()` on another control immediately after making the cover visible, i.e. focusing the hide button in the MRP

Alternate:
1. Open MRP
2. Tab to focus top button
3. Hover bottom button with mouse
4. Press enter key to "press" the top button
5. Hover style on bottom button is now stuck until above conditions are met

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[stuck_hover_mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31576256/stuck_hover_mrp.zip)
